verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a consumer email service, so the axis applies. However, no documentation in the pack describes a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Community reports that Gemini/AI features and Smart Features can be turned off describe a different control (disabling features), not opting out of telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
